description: This bar chart illustrates the average performance scores for five different models: Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, ClnGS (w/), and ClnGS. The horizontal axis displays the model names in the order Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, ClnGS (w/), and ClnGS, and is labeled “Standard Self-RAG FactTune ClnGS (w/) ClnGS”. The vertical axis, labeled “Average Performance”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals.  There are five bars, each representing a model’s average performance. The “Standard” bar is golden-yellow and extends to approximately 52. The “Self-RAG” bar is light-khaki and reaches a height of approximately 55. The “FactTune” bar is olive-green and extends to approximately 48. The “ClnGS (w/)” bar is steel-blue and reaches a height of approximately 58. Finally, the “ClnGS” bar is dark-blue and extends to a height of approximately 60. The bars are arranged in order corresponding to the labels on the horizontal axis and are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
